sources.summary_en: This is direct prior art for sequential PIT calibration testing with e-values and optional stopping. It distinguishes sequential calibration from stronger autocalibration and requires a suitable filtration. Predictable betting densities can update from past PITs; lagged forecasts need additional care. Boundary values and finite-sample power require attention. Its general method and official package prevent claiming that a PIT critic or e-process is a new invention here.

sources.summary_en: Iterative model building, checking, comparison and expansion are already part of Bayesian workflow. This supports distinguishing posterior inference within a fixed model list from revising the model space. The bounded reading establishes the conceptual precedent, not a proof for an automated online expansion algorithm. The inaccessible detailed sections are not counted as read.
